items.title: VI Live: AZ geeft zich niet gewonnen, Nijstad kopt Twente op 1-1
items.summary: Donderdagavond komen er weer vier Nederlandse clubs in actie in Europees verband. In de Europa League staat NEC tegenover Omonia Nicosia (18.45 uur) en treft AZ de Italiaanse topclub Juventus (21.00 uur). In de Conference League gaat Ajax op bezoek bij FC Midtjylland (18.45 uur) en speelt FC Twente tegen Pafos FC (21.00 uur). Je volgt de duels in deze VI Live.

items.title: Fifa wants talks over restricting women’s Olympic football to under-23s
items.summary: IOC open to dialogue and Fifa wants input from others Fifa concerned about fixture congestion and workload Fifa wants talks with the International Olympic Committee over restricting the Olympic women’s football tournament to under-23s owing to concerns over fixture congestion and the workload of senior players. The eligibility criteria for the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles has been set, with qualification tournaments having begun in some regions, so no change can be made until Brisbane 2032 at the earliest, but sources at both organisations have said that they are open to dialogue. Continue reading...

items.summary: Evanilson’s fine finish sets up 3-1 win at Sparta Prague Ferencvaros win 2-0 at Milan to maintain 100% record Bournemouth extended their winning run to seven matches as Evanilson’s wonderful late goal helped earn a 3-1 win away to 10-man Sparta Prague in the Europa League. Marco Rose’s side have enjoyed a dream start to the club’s debut European season and they will be confident of securing direct passage to the last 16 after making it four victories from four, but they were made to work hard for the points in the Czech capital. items.summary: Ajax boekte donderdagavond een klinkende overwinning op FC Midtjylland in de Conference League ( 1-6 ), maar Abdellah Ouazane was niet helemaal tevreden. De zeventienjarige aanvaller, die door Ronald de Boer een potentiële wereldster werd genoemd, was ondanks zijn assist kritisch op zijn eigen optreden in Denemarken.

items.title: Kamada’s late leveller rescues point for 10-man Crystal Palace and denies Hoffenheim
items.summary: A late, late strike from Daichi Kamada saved Crystal Palace from embarrassment and another round of navel gazing as they snatched a Europa League draw with Hoffenheim against the odds. After being outplayed by a side currently in the bottom half of the Bundesliga, and a goal down from the seventh minute, Palace looked to have lost all hope in this fixture when Adam Wharton was dismissed with 13 minutes to go. But after Hoffenheim failed to clear a goalmouth scramble in added time, Kamada fired home under the keeper to generate a rare moment of elation at Selhurst Park this season. Continue reading...

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo merely the latest example of a great player who couldn’t let go | Jonathan Wilson
items.summary: There is no doubt his international career was an incredible one, but it would have been greater still if he had not lingered on the stage so long Nothing, perhaps, is quite so difficult for an elite sportsperson as timing their exit. It’s not easy for any person in any job to weigh the hope of having more to give with the desire not to linger beyond their usefulness, but it’s perhaps particularly hard for top athletes because unrealistic self-confidence is so essential to their success. It takes an almost unhealthy level of self-belief for anybody to make the sacrifices to get to the top, to dedicate themselves to such a precarious vocation, to overcome all the setbacks and injuries and failures. How can someone – whose whole life has been spent assuring themselves there are no odds they cannot overcome – accept that is it, that the time has come to say goodbye? The news that Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international football brings with it, inevitably, a sadness. Sadness we will no longer see him skipping past a defender, or burying a neck-thrusting header, and sadness in that the end of the career of any great is a reminder of mortality; all things in time must pass. But there is also a sadness he timed his departure so badly. For at least three tournaments, there has been a sense of Ronaldo holding Portugal back. Continue reading...

items.title: Un Vitor Bruno très satisfait, mais pas encore détendu : "C'est très difficile"
items.summary: Face à Salzbourg, Anderlecht n’a pas seulement décroché une importante victoire européenne, il a aussi montré un visage qui a particulièrement plu à Vitor Bruno. Un match avec beaucoup de duels, des fautes et peu d’espaces. C’est précisément dans ce contexte que l’entraîneur a vu ce qu’il attend de son équipe : du caractère, du courage et la volonté de se battre pour chaque mètre.

items.title: Privés de plusieurs joueurs : voici la liste des U17 belges pour la Coupe du Monde

items.title: Anderlecht had eindelijk wat Vitor Bruno ook tegen Club Brugge wil zien: "Dan krijgen ze alles van mij"
items.summary: Anderlecht heeft tegen Salzburg niet alleen een belangrijke Europese overwinning geboekt, maar ook een kant van zichzelf getoond waar Vitor Bruno bijzonder tevreden over was. Het werd een wedstrijd met veel duels, stevige overtredingen en weinig ruimte. Precies daarin zag de trainer wat hij van zijn ploeg verlangt: karakter, moed en de bereidheid om voor elke meter te vechten.

items.title: De 26 Rode Duivels: verrast Mark van Bommel?
